book.name: Jon
book.title: Jon Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Jon kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: God Manö nɨpe ram mɨnöŋ iƚ i aua
Ram mɨnöŋ hadame dagol gau gɨ laga ñɨn u, God Manö mɨdeia. God Manö nɨpe God aip mɨdeia. God Manö nɨpe u rö nöp God me.
Ram mɨnöŋ hainö gɨ la; nöd yabɨƚ God Manö nɨpe God aip mɨdeia.
God nɨpe gö, God Manö nɨpe nan gau magöŋhalö gɨ la. Nan ap ke laga; nɨpe ke gɨ la nan gau nöp mɨdöp.
God Manö nɨpe kamɨŋ mɨdep iƚ u. Kamɨŋ mɨdep magö anɨbu nɨbi bɨ kalɨp mailö ña.
Mailö anɨbu amöm nɨbi bɨ sɨbön göp aŋ au mɨdpal gau ñɨ lab nɨŋöm sɨbön mailö anɨbu paƚog göl rö lagöp.
Nɨbi bɨ gau magöŋhalö Mailö anɨbu nɨp nɨŋ udöl, a göm, God bɨ ap nɨp hag lö, nɨpe apöm Bɨ Mailö halö anɨbu manö hag ñɨmɨdöp. Bɨ manö hag ñɨmɨdöp bɨ anɨbu hib nɨpe Jon.
Jon nɨpe Mailö anɨbu wasö. Nɨpe yɨharɨŋ bɨ an Mailö mɨdöp manö u nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp hag ñɨnɨg aua.
Mailö nɨŋö yabɨƚ anɨbu nɨpe ram mɨnöŋ iƚ i apöm nɨbi bɨ gau magöŋhalö kalɨp mailö ñöl gɨmɨdöp.

God Manö nɨpe ram mɨnöŋ iƚ i apöm mɨdmɨdöp. God nɨpe gö, God Manö nɨpe ke mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i gɨ löm, nɨbi bɨ gau gɨ löm ga. Pen nɨpe ke ram mɨnöŋ iƚ i ap mɨdeia u, nɨbi bɨ nɨp amgö nɨŋöm Bɨ Kub u a göm nɨŋagla.
Nɨpe ram mɨnöŋ nɨpe ke aua u pen nɨbi bɨ nɨpe ke nɨp udagla.
Pen nɨbi bɨ au, Krais manö aij nɨpe u nɨŋ udöm, nɨp Bɨ Kub hon, a göm, udla gau, kalɨp geia God ñɨ pai nɨpe mɨdpal.
God ñɨ pai nɨpe mɨdpal u, bɨ ber gau udöm, ñɨ pai yag daulö mɨdpal rö mɨdagpal. God nɨpe ke gö ñɨ pai nɨpe mɨdpal.

Pen Manö anɨbu, nɨpe apöm bɨ hañ romaŋ löm, hanɨp aip han mɨdmɨdöp. Anɨb u, hon mailö magö aij nɨpe hadö nɨŋbun. Nɨpe Bap Ñɨ nɨpe añɨ yabɨƚ u me, Bap nɨpe ke mailö magö aij ke halö mɨdöp rö, Ñɨ nɨpe u rö nöp mɨdöp. Pen nɨpe hañ romaŋ löm bɨ rö apöm, hanɨp magöŋhalö mög nɨŋöm mɨdmagö yabɨƚ löm, God Manö nɨŋö u magöŋhalö hag ñɨ aij gɨmɨdöp.

God Manö nɨpe aua u, Jon nɨpe nɨŋöm, wɨñ alöm nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp haga, “Bɨ mɨñi auöp i nöp me, yad kalöp nöd hagnö, ‘Bɨ ap nɨpe yad hain aunab u pen yɨp yag dauagep adö u, nɨpe hadame dagol gau mɨdmɨdöp. Anɨb u, nɨpe yad rö wasö; nɨpe Bɨ Kub yabɨƚ,’ a gɨnö u, bɨ anɨbu me u,” a ga.
Nɨpe hanɨp nɨbi bɨ magöŋhalö mög yabɨƚ nɨŋöm, ud aij göm, nan aij aij iru nöp ñöb.
Apiabö u lo manö adö u, God Mosɨs nɨp ñö, Mosɨs hanɨp ña u pen God nɨbi bɨ mög nɨŋöm ud aij gab manö nɨŋö anɨbu, Jisas Krais aua u me, mɨñi waiö nɨŋabun.
Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap God nɨp nɨŋagal. Ñɨ añɨ nɨpe u nöp nɨpe ke God. Nɨpe Nap aip mɨdpil. Nɨpe Nap nɨpe hag waiö la nɨŋöm mɨñi hon Bap God hadö nɨŋbun.
Jon Bɨ Ñɨg Pak Ñeb u, “Yad Mesaia u, wasö,” ga

Juda bɨ kub Jerusalem nɨbö gau kale bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ rɨmnap abe, bɨ God sabe gep ram wög gɨ ñɨmɨdal bɨ rɨmnap abe hag yuöm hagla, “Kale Jon mɨdöp ammim, ‘Ne an?’ ö gɨmim hag nɨŋmim,” a gɨla.
Kale Jon mɨdeia u amjaköm, nɨp hag nɨŋöm hagla, “Ne bɨ an?” ö gɨla. Hag nɨŋeila, nɨpe wai ñaga. Kalpe waiö hagöm haga, “Yad Krais u
wasö,” ga.

Anɨg hageia, kale pen hagla, “Anɨg hagpan u, ne an? Ne Ilaija aka?” gɨla. Anɨg hageila, Jon haga, “Yad Ilaija wasö,” ga. Anɨg hageia, kale pen hagla, “Ne bɨ God manö hagep pör abad mɨdpun u aka?” gɨla. Hageila, Jon wasö ga.
Anɨg hageia, bɨ anɨb gau pen hagla, “Anɨb u, ne an? Pen yad bɨ an a gɨmön hagnabön, hon amun bɨ kub hanɨp hag yubal gau kalɨp hag ñɨnabun,” a gɨla.
Hageila, Jon kalɨp haga, “Yad mɨñi gabin i, bɨ God manö hagep Aisaia nöd haga rö nöp gabin. Nɨpe haga,

content.text: ‘Yad bɨ ap ram mɨnöŋ nɨbi bɨ iru mɨdagpal,
ram mɨnöŋ kabö nöp mɨdöp aŋ au mɨdem, wɨñ kub alem hagabin,
adan ƚɨk gɨ aij gɨmim,” a gabin,’ a ga.

content: Yad Jon mɨñi gabin me u,” a ga.
Pen bɨ Jon nɨp hag nɨŋnɨg aula anɨb gau, bɨ Perisi rɨmnap aip aula.
Kale Jon nɨp hag nɨŋöm hagla, “Ne hagpan, yad Krais wasö, Ilaija wasö, bɨ God manö hagep abad mɨdpun u wasö gɨpan gö jɨ nɨhön gɨnɨg nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp ñɨg pak ñabön?” ö gɨla.
Hageila, Jon haga, “Yad kalɨp yɨharɨŋ ñɨg pak ñabin. Pen bɨ ap aŋ kalöp aui mɨdöp, nɨpe aigale bɨ rö mɨdöp a gɨmim nɨŋagpim.
Bɨ anɨbu nɨpe yad hain aunab pen nɨpe yad rö wasö; nɨpe bɨ kub yabɨƚ, yad bɨ pro. Yad ma rɨrup nɨpe u nagɨ hubɨknam rö lagöp,” a ga.
Jon nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp ñɨg pak ñɨmɨdöp ram rɨƚɨg agƚö Bedani, ñɨg Jodan goƚ böŋ nö lödaŋ nɨŋöm bɨ anɨb gau apöm nɨp manö anɨbu hag nɨŋla.
Jisas nɨpe God Sipsip Pi nɨpe

Ruö Jisas auö nɨŋöl göm, Jon Jisas nɨŋöm nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp haga, “Nɨŋim! God Sipsip Pi nɨpe hanɨp hag yuöp me u. Nɨpe me nɨbi bɨ mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i gau gau magöŋhalö nan si nan naij gɨpal gac u ƚɨk gɨ yunab.
Bɨ anɨbu me, yad hagnö, ‘Bɨ ap nɨpe yad hain aunab u pen yɨp yag dauagep adö u, nɨpe hadame dagol gau mɨdmɨdöp. Anɨb u, nɨpe yad rö wasö; nɨpe Bɨ Kub yabɨƚ,’ a gɨnö.
Bɨ kub anɨbu bɨ an a gem nɨŋagmɨdin. Pen Isrel nɨbi bɨ, bɨ kub anɨbu bɨ aigale bɨ rö mɨdöp u nɨŋöl a gem, kalɨp ñɨg pak ñɨnɨg aunö,” a ga.

Pen Jon Jisas manö adö anɨbu nöp hagöm haga, “Bɨ anɨbi bɨ an, a gem, yad ke nɨŋagbnep; pen bɨ yɨp hag yuö apem nɨbi bɨ kalɨp ñɨg pak ñabin u haga, ‘Ne nɨŋnabön, Ana nɨpe bɨ an apöm, aip mɨdeinab, bɨ anɨbu nöp nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp Ana Uɫ pak ñɨnab,’ a ga. Haga anɨbu me, mɨñi Ana u kumi kabö adö laŋ nɨbö yaur dapo rö u gɨ nɨp auajɨp
nɨŋem yad nɨŋ aij gem kalɨp manö nɨŋö hagabin, bɨ anɨbi nɨpe God Ñɨ nɨpe u nöp,” a ga.
Jisas bɨ nɨpe mɨhöp nöd uda
Ruö pen, Jon bɨ nɨpe mɨhau aip, kauyaŋ ap ñɨg pak ñɨmɨdöp ka u mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ,
Jisas ap padiö, Jon nɨpe Jisas nɨŋöm nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp haga, “Bɨ anɨbi God Sipsip Pi nɨpe me u,” a ga.
Anɨg hagö, Jon bɨ nɨpe mɨhau, manö anɨbu nɨŋmil, Jisas areia mɨgan u hain arlö.
Pen Jisas ado göm kalɨp mɨhöŋ nɨŋöm haga, “Nɨhön gɨnɨg auabil?” ö ga. Hageia haglö, “Rabai! Ne hanban gai?” ö gɨlö. Hibru manö hagöm “Rabai” a gɨlö manö anɨbu iƚ u “Manö Hag Ñeb Bɨ.”
Pen kale anɨg gɨmil hag nɨŋlö, Jisas haga, “Anɨb u, yad aip ammil nɨŋnabil,” a ga. Haga ñɨn anɨbu nöp dugo magö u ammil, nɨpe aip mɨdeila.
Jon bɨ nɨpe anɨb mɨhau, bɨ ap hib nɨpe Edru. Edru nɨmam nɨpe me Saimon Pida.
Edru magö anɨbu nöp am nɨmam Saimon nɨp uƚhai nɨŋöm haga, “Mesaia u aunab a gun pör abad mɨdpun u mɨñi nɨŋbul,” a ga. “Mesaia” a ga manö magö u, Grik manö hagöm “Krais” a gɨpal.

Edru anɨg hagöm, nɨmam Saimon nɨp uɫ göm Jisas mɨdeia u arö, Jisas Saimon nɨp nɨŋöm haga, “Jon ñɨ nɨpe Saimon. Nöp Sipas a göl,” a ga. Arameik manö hagöm, hib Sipas a ga manö magö anɨbu, Grik manö hagöm Pida a gɨpal. Sipas abe Pida abe iƚ añɨ anɨbu “kabö.”
Jisas Pilip aip Nadanyel aip kalɨp mɨhöŋ uda
Ruö, Jisas ram mɨnöŋ Galili arnɨg, am Pilip nɨp nɨŋöm haga, “Yad aip arul,” a ga.
Pilip, Edru, Pida, ram mɨnöŋ kale Bedsaida nɨbö.
Pen Pilip am Nadanyel nɨp nɨŋöm haga, “Hon bɨ u, Mosɨs abe, bɨ God manö hagep rɨmnap abe kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla u, nɨp mɨñi nɨŋbun. Nɨpe me Jisas, Josep ñɨ nɨpe. Ram mɨnöŋ nɨpe Nasared nɨbö,” a ga.
Pilip anɨg hageia, Nadanyel haga, “Bɨ aij ap ram mɨnöŋ naij anɨbu nɨbö auagnab,” a ga. Hageia, Pilip haga, “Anɨg hagpan u, auö am nɨŋul!” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, kale bɨ mɨhau ammil söl söl gɨlö nɨŋöl gɨ, Jisas Nadanyel nɨp nɨŋöm haga, “Bɨ anɨbu bɨ Isrel yɨjɨg göl u me, nɨpe piral adö u hagagnab; nɨpe nɨŋö nöp waiö hagnab,” a ga.
Anɨg hagö, Nadanyel haga, “Ne aige gɨmön yɨp nɨŋban?” ö ga. Hageia, Jisas haga, “Pilip nöp hainö uɫ gɨnɨg nöb; yad nöp nöd nɨŋbin, ne asɨk mɨdajan rauan iƚ au,” a ga.
Anɨg hagö, Nadanyel haga, “Manö hag ñeb bɨ. Nöp nɨŋbin! Ne God Ñɨ nɨpe, Isrel nɨbi bɨ Kiŋ hon,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, Jisas haga, “Nöp yɨharɨŋ rauan iƚ au nɨŋbin a gɨpin u me, yɨp nɨŋ udpan? Hainö nan ke nɨbö rɨmnap nɨŋnabön,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hagöm haga, “Kalöp magöŋhalö nɨŋö hagabin, kumi kabö adö laŋ au pɨral hiɨkö, ejol gau apöm, yɨp Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe nɨŋ amɨl apɨl, nɨŋ amɨl apɨl geinaböl nɨŋnabim,” a ga.

footnotes.text: manö “Krais u” abe, Hibru manö “Mesaia u” abe iƚ añɨ ap nöp mɨdöp: “God hag la Bɨ u.”
